sources.title: GitHub - chengmanov/apertus-swiss-eval: Apertus-8B four-way ablations ...
sources.snippet: apertus-swiss-eval — small-model evaluations for Swiss regulated domains Open, reproducible four-way ablations of Apertus-8B (the open Swiss LLM from EPFL / ETH / CSCS) on Swiss regulated question-answering, one subfolder per domain. Every task asks a short factual question and requires a citation to the exact legal unit it rests on; everything is scored deterministically — no LLM judge.
